name: MotionClone
description: [ICLR 2025] Official implementation of MotionClone: Training-Free Motion Cloning for Controllable Video Generation
readme: This repository is the official implementation of MotionClone. It is a training-free framework that enables motion cloning from a reference video for controllable video generation, without cumbersome video inversion processes. Click for the full abstract of MotionClone
